stability.stop: A complete independent seeded campaign across every profile made no nominal improvement; every profile also stopped after at least 50,000 valid proposals and 25 non-improving epochs plus exact neighborhood audit.

research.title: Pocket Planes optimization · Evan Diewald
research.finding: Optimizes trips, fleets and airport portfolios using calibrated observations, value iteration and a constrained portfolio model. Inspected the README, portfolio model, value iteration and toy MDP at commit 6f661d1eac4932ca51e9f8450255cd8ff09cee31.
research.applied: Applied reproducible random experiments and separate evaluation seeds. Pocket Planes profit, airport population and delivery bonuses are not assumed to apply to Pocket Trains.

research.title: Pocket Planes agent simulation · kcelebi
research.finding: An agent-based Processing simulation separating agents, game state and actions. Inspected its implementation: several optimizer classes are placeholders and flight time is hardcoded, so it is not a verified global optimizer.
research.applied: Useful separation of jobs, vehicles and time for future calibrated simulation; the present tool makes no vehicle-dispatch or earnings claim.

research.title: Pocket Planes 2.0 route calculator
research.finding: A route-calculator project derived from earlier community calculators. Its route utilities check range, distance and airport eligibility; this is not a complete network-layout solver.
research.applied: Applied the principle that feasibility must be checked independently of the score. Train choice remains separate from this engine-agnostic ownership model.

research.title: Pocket Planes distance calculations
research.finding: Documents wraparound distance calculations for a changed Pocket Planes map. Geometry and version assumptions can change preferred routes.
research.applied: Stress-tested the eight provisional Pocket Trains distances. No free-flight or wraparound connections were added to the fixed rail map.

research.title: Recombination: spanning trees and connected partitions
research.finding: ReCom explores connected partitions by merging neighboring regions and cutting a random spanning tree.
research.applied: Inspired connected two- and three-railroad repartitions on the track line graph, with a weighted planning cap. Our asymmetric annealing proposals are heuristic optimization, not stationary posterior sampling.

research.title: Pocket Trains game implementations inspected
research.finding: Search also found this game project and TheIceCreamBear/PocketTrains, a clone. Neither was verified as a complete global track-layout solver.
research.applied: No external project code was copied or executed. Layouts and scores here are independently computed from the supplied tracker map.

research.title: Pocket Trains official App Store version history
research.finding: Version 1.9 introduced Metro Electric and Petabyte Electric with electrified tracks and zero-fuel operation. Later notes describe engine/fuel-car management fixes. This version history does not independently validate the supplied map or its prices.
research.applied: Kept track distance as an explicit routing proxy instead of claiming literal fuel consumption for every engine. Vehicle speed, capacity, electrification and operating costs remain outside the engine-agnostic objective.

fixed.method: Replica-exchange annealing with uniform-spanning-tree repartition, split/merge moves and exact all-pairs scoring
fixed.partition_encoding: Edge order IDS and label order NAMES from deep_search; arrays retain every supplied starting layout
fixed.interpretation: Heuristic optimization, not posterior sampling or proof of global optimality. Asymmetric proposals are not claimed to sample a stationary target distribution.

assumptions.station_popularity: Independent exchangeable lognormal weights, sigma 0.75; not measured population
assumptions.job_batch: Poisson jobs per virtual day, multinomial destinations

demand.interpretation: 90% intervals describe these synthetic scenario draws. They are not confidence intervals for real gameplay. Lower-cost fractions are not probabilities of real-world success.

uncertain_distances.prior: Each of the 8 provisional track distances independently uniform between 70% and 130% of its current estimate, rounded to positive integers
uncertain_distances.interpretation: Distance priors are assumptions. Cap exceedance concerns the arbitrary planning bound, not an engine fuel tank. Known distances stay fixed; no city pair is dropped.

promotion_rule: Nominal improvements must be verified on all 9,591 pairs, meet ownership constraints and pass construction/correction scheduling checks. Synthetic demand results do not establish actual profits.
limitations: Engine-agnostic route and handoff stress tests. No empirically calibrated Pocket Trains job generator, train positions, capacity, dispatch policy or earnings simulator.
